correctness.rationale: In undirected homogeneous three-uniform clique projection each triple contributes pair weights 1/3, making M=3(I+L) symmetric PD and z=3M^{-1}s. Every connected labeled triple system for n=3,4,5 was represented by the complete subset enumeration; every absent triple and binary opinion vector up to exact complement symmetry was checked with rational arithmetic. Independently reproduced 11 connected n=4 hypergraphs with 128 comparisons and 958 connected n=5 hypergraphs with 73,760 comparisons, none increasing; n=3 is vacuous. For n=6 the connected 3-edge system {(1,2,5),(1,3,6),(1,4,5)}, added T=(1,2,4), and s=(0,0,0,0,1,0) yields exact delta P(t)=2t(553t+424)/[8427(19t+53)^2]>0 for every t>0, and 977/21842784 at t=1. Independently checked the claimed rational equilibrium and polynomial identity. Three old triples are minimal to connect six vertices. Universal n<=5 bound is for unit added weight only, not arbitrary t.
